title: Despite Hearings to Close it, Hunters Way has Fresh Gravel. | Taxpayer's Watchdog Group
text:
Despite Hearings to Close it, Hunters Way has Fresh Gravel. April 20, 2026
 You’ll be pleased to know the county was doing fresh crush and run on Hunters Way the morning of April 15, 2026. Another questionable way our county spends money.
The BOC has held two (2) public hearings concerning the closing of Hunters Way through Burnt Pine Farm/Hunting/Clay Shooting area. There has been no one that has spoken in support of this closing at either meeting. There have been citizens speaking against the closing at each meeting.
Hunters Way appears to be a well maintained Jasper County gravel road, and on April 15, 2026 the tradition of keeping it well graveled was continued–despite the county planning to abandon it and give it to Burnt Pine.
Citizens, be informed and stay informed! Only by being informed, can the citizens understand what is being done and talked about, and then press our officials to make good decisions for everyone in Jasper County.
